# Free Google Maps Lead Scraper & B2B Contact Email Extractor (Full Documentation)

> The complete technical specification, API reference, benchmarks, and integration documentation for the open-source Google Maps Lead Scraper & B2B Contact Email Extractor by Neon Innovation Lab.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Capabilities

The Free Google Maps Lead Scraper is an open-source data extraction pipeline designed to solve the two biggest bottlenecks in B2B outbound prospecting:
1. Extracting high-volume, verified local business records directly from Google Maps without IP blocks or CAPTCHAs.
2. Enriching each business record with direct contact emails and social media profiles (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube) extracted directly from each company's official domain.

### Key Benchmark Metrics
- **Initial Free Tier:** First 50 leads per run incur $0.00 custom event charges.
- **Monthly Platform Allowance:** Every Apify account includes $5.00/month in free platform credits.
- **Pay-Per-Event Unit Cost:** $0.03 Actor start fee + $0.005 per lead extracted + $0.002 per dataset item.
- **Effective Cost per 1,000 Leads:** ~$7.03 total (compared to $25–$35 for Outscraper and $69–$149/mo for PhantomBuster).
- **Execution Memory:** 128MB–256MB RAM per run.
- **Contact Extraction Latency:** ~200ms per website using Cheerio HTML parsing.
- **Email Validation:** Filters tracking pixels, binary extensions (`.png`, `.svg`, `.woff`), and dummy placeholders (`example.com`).

---

## 2. Output Schema & Data Structure

Every extracted lead is exported with the following schema:

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `title` | `string` | The registered business name on Google Maps | `"Greater Austin Roof Pros"` |
| `category` | `string` | Primary Google Maps business category | `"Roofing contractor"` |
| `address` | `string` | Physical street address | `"1201 E 11th St, Austin, TX 78702"` |
| `phone` | `string` | Direct telephone number | `"(512) 555-0199"` |
| `website` | `string` | Canonical company website URL | `"https://www.austinroofpros.com"` |
| `emails` | `array<string>`| Syntax-cleaned contact emails from company website | `["contact@austinroofpros.com"]` |
| `socials` | `object` | Verified company social links | `{"linkedin": "...", "facebook": "..."}` |
| `rating` | `number` | Google star rating (1.0 to 5.0) | `4.9` |
| `reviewsCount` | `integer`| Total number of Google customer reviews | `218` |
| `googleMapsUrl`| `string` | Direct URL to the Google Maps listing | `"https://www.google.com/maps/place/..."`|
| `query` | `string` | Original search query executed | `"Roofers in Austin, TX"` |
| `scrapedAt` | `string` | ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of extraction | `"2026-10-19T10:15:30.000Z"` |

### Sample JSON Object
```json
{
  "title": "Greater Austin Roof Pros",
  "category": "Roofing contractor",
  "address": "1201 E 11th St, Austin, TX 78702",
  "phone": "(512) 555-0199",
  "website": "https://www.austinroofpros.com",
  "emails": [
    "contact@austinroofpros.com",
    "estimates@austinroofpros.com"
  ],
  "socials": {
    "linkedin": "https://www.linkedin.com/company/austin-roof-pros",
    "facebook": "https://www.facebook.com/austinroofpros",
    "instagram": "https://www.instagram.com/austinroofpros"
  },
  "rating": 4.9,
  "reviewsCount": 218,
  "googleMapsUrl": "https://www.google.com/maps/place/Greater+Austin+Roof+Pros",
  "query": "Roofers in Austin, TX",
  "scrapedAt": "2026-10-19T10:15:30.000Z"
}
```

---

## 3. Input Parameters & Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `searchQueries` | `array<string>` | Yes | `["Coffee shops in Austin, TX"]` | List of category + city search queries. |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | `integer` | No | `50` | Maximum leads to collect per query (First 50 free). |
| `extractEmailsAndSocials`| `boolean` | No | `true` | When true, visits each domain to harvest emails and social profiles. |
| `countryCode` | `string` | No | `"us"` | Two-letter ISO country code (`us`, `ca`, `gb`, `au`, `de`). |

---

## 4. Quickstart Implementations

### Python Implementation
```python
import os
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient(os.getenv("APIFY_TOKEN"))

run_input = {
    "searchQueries": ["Plumbers in Dallas, TX"],
    "maxResultsPerQuery": 50,
    "extractEmailsAndSocials": True,
    "countryCode": "us"
}

run = client.actor("neon_innovation_lab/google-maps-b2b-lead-enricher").call(run_input=run_input)

for lead in client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).iterate_items():
    print(f"Title: {lead['title']}, Phone: {lead['phone']}, Emails: {lead['emails']}")
```

### Node.js Implementation
```javascript
import { ApifyClient } from 'apify-client';

const client = new ApifyClient({
  token: process.env.APIFY_TOKEN,
});

const run = await client.actor('neon_innovation_lab/google-maps-b2b-lead-enricher').call({
  searchQueries: ['Roofers in Austin, TX'],
  maxResultsPerQuery: 50,
  extractEmailsAndSocials: true,
  countryCode: 'us',
});

const { items } = await client.dataset(run.defaultDatasetId).listItems();
console.log(`Extracted ${items.length} leads with emails and socials.`);
```

## 5. Pricing Comparison Benchmark

| Platform | Pricing Model | First 50 Leads | Cost per 1,000 Leads | Deep Contact Enrichment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **This Scraper (Apify)** | Pay-per-event | **$0.00 (Free)** | **~$7.03** | **Included (Emails + Socials)** |
| **Outscraper** | Pre-paid balance | $2.00 trial | $25.00 – $35.00 | Separate fee per email lookup |
| **PhantomBuster** | $69/mo recurring | 14-day trial | ~$40.00 – $80.00 | Fails on single-page apps |
| **ScrapingBee** | $49/mo credit pack | 1,000 credits | ~$20.00 – $40.00 | Raw HTML only (no email parsing)|
| **Apollo.io / ZoomInfo** | $99/mo to $10,000/yr | Limited credits | $150.00 – $300.00 | Directory records often stale |

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Is scraping Google Maps legal?
A: Yes. Scraping publicly available business information on Google Maps and company websites is legal in the United States under federal case law (*hiQ Labs v. LinkedIn*). 

### Q: How are the contact emails extracted?
A: When a business listing includes an official website URL, the scraper fetches the homepage and checks primary contact paths (`/contact`, `/about`, `/team`). It parses the HTML using Cheerio, runs regex extraction, eliminates spam honeypots, and syntax-validates email formats.

### Q: Can I connect this to Clay or n8n?
A: Yes. Both Clay (via HTTP API Enrichment) and n8n (via Apify Node or Webhook) can trigger runs and receive enriched leads directly into outbound tables.
